title: The Shores
address:
SW corner of Vine St and 9th St
Daytona Beach, Florida 32117
United States
description:
The Shores is a new three-story, 80-unit affordable family housing development in Daytona Beach, including 33 accessible units for residents with mobility, hearing, or visual impairments.

On-site amenities include a clubhouse, a health services center, a fitness center, a resort-style pool, and a dog park.
